items.reason: The PR replaces an atomic DELETE with separate selection and deletion at pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:549-556; the helpers use separate sessions and delete solely by captured IDs (:591-593, :616-622). Concurrent deletion through :413-419 can remove a newer annotation between these operations, promoting a selected victim into the newest MaxCount rows without preventing its deletion. This can permanently delete annotations that now fall within the retention window, constituting persisted-data loss under the severity rubric.
